verdict.rationale: Lambda exposes a full REST API for programmatically launching/terminating instances and clusters, supports cloud-init for automated provisioning, and allows headless SSH access to run jobs without any UI — all suitable building blocks for CI/automation pipelines. However, there is no first-party CLI/SDK, no documented CI integration examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and the only agent-oriented tooling found is a third-party unofficial CLI/MCP wrapper, not something Lambda ships itself. Missing for 10: official CLI/SDK, first-party CI/CD integration docs, and independent verification of headless automation at scale.
